summary: Design-spec review of desktop-workbench-core interface v2 against plan revision 2, plan-review-r2.json, existing main/preload contracts and installed @opencode/client 2.0.18 declarations found no blocking implementability defects. The closed IPC operations, authoritative snapshots, catalog availability, permission responses and interruption reconciliation are compatible with the inspected sources. Previously resolved concerns remain settled. Exact adapter payloads, runtime behavior, boundary enforcement and rendered accessibility require implementation verification; their pending verification is not a defect in this bounded interface. Review was read-only; no edits, tests, SDK execution, credential access or delegation occurred.
